info.name: Agentic SDLC - URL Shortener
info.description:
Run top-to-bottom with the Collection Runner (order matters: later requests use run ids saved by earlier ones).
Start the app first: ./mvnw spring-boot:run
IMPORTANT: In Settings (or Runner) turn OFF 'Automatically follow redirects' so redirect tests see the 302.

The agents run on local Ollama models (see GET /api/v1/sdlc/agents). The content assertions in the scenario folders (exact task counts, files, plan versions) match the deterministic strategies. For fully reproducible runs, start the app with OLLAMA_ENABLED=false. With Ollama on, the same flows and gates run, but model-written content varies.

item.name: Redirect (turn OFF 'Automatically follow redirects' in settings)

exec: pm.test("feedback became a task", () => pm.expect(j.plan.tasks.map(t => t.title).join()).to.include("reviewer feedback"));
pm.test("asks about fast + secure", () => { const ids = j.spec.ambiguities.map(a => a.id); pm.expect(ids).to.include("AMB-FAST"); pm.expect(ids).to.include("AMB-SECURE"); });

request.description: Which Ollama model serves each agent, whether Ollama is reachable, which models are missing (with the ollama pull commands) and per-agent LLM call stats.

exec: pm.test("8 LLM agents, each with a model", () => { pm.expect(b.agents).to.have.length(8); b.agents.forEach(a => pm.expect(a.model).to.be.a('string')); });
pm.test("implementation uses the coder model", () => pm.expect(b.agents.find(a => a.agent === 'implementation').model).to.include('coder'));
